clips.title: The story
paras: In the bustling town of Thelsamar, cook Vidra Hearthstove keeps the local laborers and miners fed with a famous highland staple: blood sausages. Preparing this hearty dwarven fare requires freshly gathered ingredients from the surrounding valley of Loch Modan.

Thelsamar is never short on hungry appetites. Between energetic children and weary miners returning from the Ironband Excavation, Vidra Hearthstove works tirelessly over the tavern stove. To keep the populace fed and satisfied, she relies on a local culinary tradition known across Loch Modan: savory blood sausages made from the wildlife wandering the rugged mountain pass.

While traditional blood sausage relies on fresh blood, seasoned meat, and natural casings, Vidra's recipe reflects the rugged pragmatism of the dwarves. Boar intestines provide the casings, bear meat forms the dense filling, and spider ichor is added to lend a sharp, pungent bite. Though collecting venomous fluid and entrails is not for the faint of heart, the result is a regional favorite that travelers quickly learn to appreciate.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: There's never a shortage of empty bellies here in Thelsamar, kids running in and out, workers from the excavation coming in after a hard day's work. We're famous for our blood sausages, I don't suppose you've ever tried them?
No? Well, around here you've got to work for your meals, and don't think just because you're a fancy adventurer, you'll be any exception.
I'll need bear meat, boar intestines for the casings, and spider ichor for spice. You get me some of those, and leave the cooking to Vidra!

clips.title: Progress
paras: I'm all ready to start cooking, do you have the ingredients for me?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Trust me, it seems a lot harder than it looks, but...
Oh, I've never known someone to take much interest in the making of sausages, but I'll give you the recipe just in case. Here you go, mind you eat them fresh!
